# MenuActivation

`Flare.Components.MenuActivation`

How a FlareMenu is opened from its activator.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LeftClick` | `0` | A normal left click / tap toggles the menu (default). |
| `RightClick` | `1` | A right click (context-menu gesture) opens the menu and suppresses the browser menu - pair with PositionAtCursor for a true context menu. |

## Used by components

- `FlareMenu`
